title: Longest Turbulent Subarray
summary: Return the length of the longest contiguous segment in which comparisons between neighbors strictly alternate between less-than and greater-than.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Return the length of the longest contiguous segment in which comparisons between neighbors strictly alternate between less-than and greater-than. Equal neighbors break a segment. A single value qualifies.

examples.explanation: The comparisons go down, up, down.
Only the unequal middle pair can be extended beyond length one.
A single value has no comparison to violate.

hints: Conceptual: The comparison signs matter more than the differences.
Directional: Track the longest suffix for each possible final comparison direction.
Implementation: An upward step extends a downward suffix and resets the downward length to one. Reverse the roles for a downward step, and reset both for equality.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
